profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at UnitedHealth Group (Optum) | 19+ Years in Enterprise-Scale Applications | AI/ML, GenAI, RAG & NLP
profile.geoLocationName: Morris Plains, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Lead Software Engineer with 19+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale applications across healthcare, insurance, and financial services. At UnitedHealth Group (Optum), I lead and contribute to platform modernization, architecture, integrations, AI-enabled solutions, and production delivery.
My responsibilities span the software lifecycle: partnering with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translating workflows into technical designs, developing and reviewing solutions, optimizing performance and data access, supporting CI/CD, and resolving production issues. I collaborate with engineering, QA, business, and distributed teams to deliver reliable systems aligned with operational needs.
At Optum, I have contributed to Benefit Template Builder (BTB), which supports Key Accounts and National Accounts benefits workflows. My work includes modernization and instance-consolidation initiatives, Merit-to-BTB automation, AI-assisted integrations, and business workflow enhancements. I also built a DBS Crosswalk automation platform that converts Excel and PDF rate-detail files into structured, reviewable instructions. Its regression suite includes 201 test cases across 32 test classes. In addition, I delivered 20+ BTB enhancements and defect resolutions and supported an AI chatbot for National Accounts Guide information retrieval.
My experience includes C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, microservices, React, TypeScript, Redux, Angular, Java/Spring, REST APIs, SQL Server, MongoDB, and distributed systems. I have worked with Azure, GCP, OpenShift, Docker, Jenkins, TFS, GitHub, and SonarQube. I also build AI-enabled solutions, including NLP and RAG applications, with attention to validation, auditability, and human review.
Earlier, I contributed to enterprise insurance, public housing, and request-management platforms, including Duck Creek integrations and housing program workflows.
Specialties: Technical Architecture • .NET • Microservices • React • AI/ML • NLP/RAG • Cloud Platforms • Enterprise Integration • CI/CD • Technical Leadership

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead full-stack engineering and solution architecture for enterprise healthcare platforms and AI-enabled capabilities at Optum.

Responsibilities
• Translate business objectives into architecture and delivery roadmaps, defining service boundaries, data readiness, evaluation criteria, rollout plans, and adoption paths.
• Design and integrate applications across .NET, Python, React, Angular, MongoDB, SQL, REST APIs, API Gateway, and Java/Spring Boot services.
• Establish AI safeguards for prompt injection, PII-aware handling, least-privilege tool use, validation, logging, and human review.
• Deploy containerized workloads on OpenShift and GCP, aligning solutions with security, observability, resiliency, cost, and performance needs.

Selected projects
• Benefit Template Builder (BTB): Modernized a monolithic benefits configuration platform into cloud-native ASP.NET Core/.NET microservices to improve scalability, maintainability, and release agility.
• GenAI knowledge assistant prototypes: Designed RAG workflows for benefits configuration and enterprise knowledge retrieval using embeddings, chunking, semantic/vector search, prompt orchestration, citations, and secure APIs.
• Payer operations integrations: Integrated BTB with SCI, ACIS, TOPS/UNET, and iBAAG to support cross-platform operations and data consistency.
• UI modernization: Guided SPA architecture and AngularJS transitions to Angular 10+ or React 16+, using shared components and state-management patterns.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description:
Supported Trustmark enterprise applications as a Hexaware consultant, contributing to ASP.NET MVC and Web API architecture and defining extensible service boundaries for scalable business workflows.
• Developed AngularJS single-page applications integrated with backend APIs for operational workflows.
• Designed WCF service integrations and Entity Framework data-access patterns for transactional processing and data ingestion.
• Optimized SQL Server access to support high-volume operations and analytics-ready data.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
As a Syntel consultant assigned to UnitedHealth Group, provided technical leadership for CIT/FI enterprise platforms spanning AngularJS/Knockout front ends, .NET/Web API services, backend integrations, and business-rule-driven workflows.
• Defined service-oriented and microservices transition strategies using ASP.NET Core while maintaining WCF integrations.
• Established CI/CD and code quality practices using TFS, Jenkins, and SonarQube.
• Optimized SQL Server workloads supporting policy search, reporting, and financial operations.
• Implemented cloud-ready integrations using Azure Service Bus and Service Fabric to support resilient communication between services.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Designed and delivered enterprise insurance platforms for Syntel’s client, Prosight Insurance, including Duck Creek integrations supporting policy administration workflows.
• Integrated Duck Creek with core insurance systems to enable reliable data exchange across policy workflows.
• Developed ExtJS and ASP.NET MVC applications for underwriting and policy operations.
• Architected WCF middleware to support high-volume policy and financial transactions.
• Built Entity Framework data-access layers and optimized SQL Server queries and stored procedures for transactional workloads.
• Coordinated with business stakeholders, integration teams, and QA to deliver maintainable solutions aligned with insurance requirements.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Designed and developed enterprise ticketing and incident-management solutions for service operations, workflow automation, and reporting.
• Built Windows Forms applications, InfoPath workflows, and automation modules to streamline operational processes.
• Implemented WCF reporting services for dynamic PDF and Word document generation.
• Collaborated with business and technical teams to meet reliability, performance, and maintainability requirements.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
Led delivery of enterprise Windows Forms applications for British Telecom, supporting complex workflows and high-volume user interactions.
• Designed and developed a multi-tab Windows Forms application for business workflows.
• Architected ADO.NET data-access layers across Oracle and SQL Server for reliable, consistent data operations.
• Applied structured data-access patterns across relational platforms to improve portability and maintainability.
• Led release management and production deployments, coordinating builds and rollouts.
• Partnered with QA and operations teams on production stability, issue resolution, and release governance.

positions.title: S/W Programmer
positions.description:
Designed and developed ASP.NET applications supporting housing administration workflows and secure tenant and property data management.
• Built data-migration utilities and SQL optimization routines to improve data consistency, performance, and reliability during platform upgrades.
• Implemented role-based security to enforce access controls across applications.
• Developed reusable UI components and shared modules to support consistent, faster feature delivery.
• Worked with functional teams to align technical solutions with business requirements and operational standards.

projects.title: BTB-to-DBS Integration and AI-Assisted Mapping | Optum, UnitedHealth Group
projects.description:
Designed and delivered an integration platform that transforms Benefit Template Builder (BTB) data into structured downstream records. The solution combines AI-assisted mapping recommendations with deterministic, approved transformation rules to support consistent and auditable processing.

Implemented field-level validation, comment mapping, source-to-target simulation, exception handling, reusable transformation capabilities, and audit history. Established a human-in-the-loop workflow for business users to review, accept, reject, or edit AI recommendations before mappings are validated and activated. This approach applies AI within governed production controls and provides a foundation for expanding enterprise integration and workflow automation.

Technologies: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, MongoDB, SQL Server, REST APIs, AI-assisted mapping, deterministic transformation rules.

projects.title: Benefit Template Builder (BTB) | Optum, UnitedHealth Group
projects.description:
As Technical Lead/Architect, contributed to BTB, an enterprise benefits platform used by Optum’s Key Accounts and National Accounts teams to capture standard and customized medical coverage, including state-mandated benefits for small and large groups. BTB streams benefit structures to downstream plan-installation systems, including iBAAG, ACIS, TOPS/UNET, and SCI, and supports Certificate of Coverage and claims-management workflows through integrations with SCI and CIT.

Led and contributed to modernization planning and delivery, including moving capabilities from a monolithic architecture toward microservices and consolidating Key Accounts and National Accounts application instances. Worked with business stakeholders to analyze legacy functionality, gather requirements, define technical designs, and prioritize changes toward the strategic target architecture.

Developed React interfaces and REST service integrations using React, Ant Design, Axios, Redux, Java, and Spring. Also contributed to performance tuning, SQL optimization, code reviews, proof-of-concept work, and DevOps practices supporting application delivery.

Technologies: React, Ant Design, Axios, Redux, Java, Spring Boot, REST, SQL Server, OpenShift, GCP, Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD, SonarQube, Splunk.
